findings.title: PTC Trust Center Advisory: Remote Code Execution Vulnerability in PTC Windchill and FlexPLM (CVE-2026-12569)
findings.summary_md: PTC published a critical advisory on June 17, 2026 identifying CVE-2026-12569, an improper input validation and unsafe deserialization flaw in PTC Windchill PDMLink and FlexPLM that allows remote code execution. The advisory notes patches began shipping the same day for affected versions including 11.0 M030 through 13.1.3 and that the vulnerability could allow an unauthorized user to execute code remotely. PTC also began publishing network IOCs such as attacker C2 IP 5.180.41.35 and known JSP webshell patterns like /Windchill/login/[0-9a-f]{16}.jsp, along with detection rules for the malicious header X-windchill-req.

findings.title: CISA Adds Exploited PTC Windchill RCE Flaw to KEV Catalog (CVE-2026-12569)
findings.summary_md: CISA added CVE-2026-12569 to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities Catalog on June 25, 2026, citing evidence of active exploitation. The bulletin confirms the vulnerability affects PTC Windchill and FlexPLM and requires federal civilian agencies to apply patches or mitigations on an emergency timeline per BOD 26-04. This was the first-ever PTC product vulnerability added to CISA KEV, signaling widespread in-the-wild exploitation rather than theoretical risk.

findings.title: CISA Confirms Active Exploitation of PTC Windchill RCE and Web Shell Deployment (Jun 26, 2026)
findings.summary_md: On June 26, 2026, The Hacker News reported CISA's KEV addition for CVE-2026-12569 (CVSS 9.3) and noted PTC confirmed heightened threat activity with attackers deploying persistent JSP web shells in /Windchill/login/ directories. The article lists additional attacker C2 IPs including 38.60.157.212 and 216.152.148.54, and describes hunting hints such as searching HTTP logs for POST to /Windchill/login/*.jsp, scanning for .jsp files matching hex patterns, checking for flst.txt in /tmp, blocking header X-windchill-req:, and restricting internet exposure of Windchill login endpoints.

findings.title: Clop Ransomware Exploits PTC Windchill Zero-Day: 43 Victims Named (Aug 31, 2026)
findings.summary_md: Shattered.io published a detailed analysis on August 31, 2026 documenting the Clop group's exploitation of CVE-2026-12569 in PTC Windchill and FlexPLM, confirming 43 listed victims including GE, Philips, and Shell. The report states researchers at ReliaQuest confirmed active exploitation using a custom Java-based webshell placed inside /Windchill/login/ with hexadecimal filenames. It also notes Clop began exploiting the flaw as a zero-day by early June before the June 17 patch, and that SecurityWeek put the victim count at 43 with claimed data volumes from roughly 1 GB to multiple terabytes per organization.
